patterns.visual_metaphor: Nodes as VGroup(Circle, Text) and Edges as Arrow with explicit hierarchical coordinate offsets
animation_strategy: Construct root and child nodes with FadeIn
Connect parent to child using GrowArrow(Arrow(parent[0].get_bottom(), child[0].get_top(), buff=0.1, color=GRAY))
Traverse tree by indicating entire node: self.play(Indicate(curr_node, color=YELLOW))
Highlight traversed edge: self.play(arrow.animate.set_color(YELLOW))
Clear temporary search labels using FadeOut before next action
In loops with updaters, bind default args: lambda mob, target=node: mob.next_to(target, UP)

patterns.visual_metaphor: Row of adjacent Square/Rectangle cells with centered values and bottom index labels
animation_strategy: Display array with Create(cells)
Use pointers: pointer = Arrow(start=DOWN, end=UP, color=YELLOW).next_to(cells[i], DOWN, buff=0.2)
Move pointer: self.play(pointer.animate.next_to(cells[j], DOWN, buff=0.2))
Highlight comparison: self.play(cells[i][0].animate.set_fill(YELLOW, opacity=0.6))
Swap cells visually using animate: self.play(cells[i].animate.move_to(cells[j].get_center()), cells[j].animate.move_to(cells[i].get_center()), run_time=0.5)
After animating a swap, update the Python list to stay in sync: cells[i], cells[j] = cells[j], cells[i]
AVOID CyclicReplace for indexed arrays — it animates positions but does NOT reorder VGroup indices

patterns.visual_metaphor: Nodes positioned at defined 2D coordinates with connecting Line/Arrow edges
patterns.builder_snippet: nodes = {name: VGroup(Circle(radius=0.35, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to(pos), Text(name, font_size=20).move_to(pos)) for name, pos in positions.items()}
animation_strategy: FadeIn all nodes, then Create all connecting edges with LaggedStart
Traverse with wavefront: self.play(Indicate(nodes[u]), edges[(u,v)].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
Mark visited: self.play(nodes[v][0].animate.set_fill(GREEN, opacity=0.8))

patterns.visual_metaphor: Axes with plotted curves, moving Dot via ValueTracker, and dynamic TangentLine
patterns.builder_snippet:
axes = Axes(x_range=[-3.5, 3.5, 1], y_range=[-1, 5, 1], x_length=7.5, y_length=4.5).to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.6)
curve = axes.plot(lambda x: 0.35*x**2, x_range=[-3.0, 3.0], color=BLUE)
t = ValueTracker(-2.5)
dot = always_redraw(lambda: Dot(axes.c2p(t.get_value(), 0.35*t.get_value()**2), color=YELLOW))
# alpha must be clamped to [0.001, 0.999] — it is arc-length proportion not cartesian x.
# Use axes.get_secant_slope_group() instead if you need a visual tangent tied to x-position.
slope_group = always_redraw(lambda: axes.get_secant_slope_group(t.get_value(), curve, dx=0.01, secant_line_length=3, secant_line_color=GREEN))
animation_strategy: Draw axes and curve: self.play(Create(axes), Create(curve))
Add dynamic tracker dot: self.add(dot)
For tangent visualization: self.add(slope_group) — uses get_secant_slope_group tied to x-value tracker
Animate variable: self.play(t.animate.set_value(2.0), run_time=3, rate_func=linear)
AVOID: TangentLine with linear alpha mapping — alpha is arc-length proportion [0,1], not the x-coordinate

patterns.visual_metaphor: MathTex parts transformed sequentially using TransformMatchingTex
patterns.builder_snippet:
step1 = MathTex('a^2 + b^2 = c^2', font_size=40).move_to(UP)
step2 = MathTex('c = \\sqrt{a^2 + b^2}', font_size=40).move_to(UP)
animation_strategy: Write initial formula: self.play(Write(step1))
Transform to next step: self.play(TransformMatchingTex(step1, step2))
Box key result: box = SurroundingRectangle(step2, color=YELLOW); self.play(Create(box))
